claims.statement: INT-SCME supplies the first-cumulant lower bound after proper prime-power subtraction.
Selected primorial residues satisfy the registered collision-energy bound.
Under an HQ-polylog variance input, selected-residue Cauchy works exactly for 2 delta < rho < 1-delta.
The standard unconditional large-sieve variance cannot enter a post-terminal polynomial band.
Given INT-SCVAR, INT-SCPT is equivalent to INT-SCME rather than a smaller target.
INT-SCME does not imply INT-SOCG; INT-LCSK and INT-PWOC remain open.
